rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_DLL
{
    meta:
        description = "Detects common Cobalt Strike beacon DLLs via strings and patterns"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "MITRE ATT&CK T1071.001"
        maltype = "Beacon"
    strings:
        $beacon1 = "beacon.dll" nocase
        $beacon2 = "Start" ascii wide
        $beacon3 = "HttpSendRequest" api
        $beacon4 = "kernel32.dll" nocase
    condition:
        all of ($beacon*)
}
